changelog: **Stage-change notifications follow the reader's language for marketing stages** (#2710, follow-up). A stage change snapshots a non-canonical stage's label into the notification params in the writer's locale, so a Turkish reader's bell said "New lead → Proposal sent". `notificationText.ts` now reads an untouched curated snapshot back through `curatedStageLabel()` (`src/lib/programTemplates.ts`); a label the tenant typed still renders verbatim. Also corrects the `verticalOverlays.ts` comment that claimed `stageLabel()` already localized the funnel.

en: Notifications about a lead changing stage now name the stages in your own language.
tr: Bir müşteri adayının aşama değiştirdiğini bildiren bildirimler artık aşamaları kendi dilinizde gösteriyor.
de: Benachrichtigungen über einen Phasenwechsel eines Leads nennen die Phasen jetzt in Ihrer Sprache.
